title: [Qingdu Wenxin Formula mitigates doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity via inhibition of cGAS/STING/NF-kappaB pathway-mediated inflammation].
authors: Yang, Zhi; Wang, Jun; Gao, Sheng; Sun, Xiao-Qian; Zhao, Jiang-Feng; He, Jia-le; Yue, Jian-Wei; Xu, Jiang-Lin; Wang, Wei; Li, Chun
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过cGAS/STING/NF-kappaB通路减轻阿霉素心脏毒性，属纯湿实验与信号通路验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: To investigate the protective effect and mechanism of Qingdu Wenxin Formula(QD-WXF) against doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity(DIC), as well as the regulatory effect of QD-WXF on the cyclic guanosine monophosphate-adenosine monophosphate synthetase(cGAS)/stimulator of interferon genes(STING)/nuclear factor(NF)-kappaB signaling pathway. C57BL/6J mice were randomized into control, model, pravastatin(40 mg.kg~(-1)), and low-(1.3 g.kg~(-1)), medium-(2.6 g.kg~(-1)), and high-dose(5.2 g.kg~(-1)) QD-WXF groups. The mouse model of DIC was established through tail vein injection of doxorubicin, followed by four weeks of gavage. The cardiac function was evaluated by echocardiography, lactate dehydrogenase(LDH) assay, and troponin Ⅰ(TNⅠ) assay. Myocardial histopathology was assessed via hematoxylin-eosin and Masson's trichrome staining. RT-qPCR was conducted to measure the mRNA levels of interleukin(IL)-6, tumor necrosis factor(TNF)-alpha, and IL-1beta in the cardiac tissue. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to predict key pathways associated with QD-WXF and DIC, while Western blot to assess the protein level of STING. The mice with STING knockout(STING~(KO)) were prepared to validate the expression changes of proteins involved in the STING pathway and inflammation. The results of the animal experiment showed the low, medium and high doses of QD-WXF increased the ejection fraction(EF) and fractional shortening(FS) to different extents, reduced the myocardial injury markers LDH and TNⅠ, down-regulated the mRNA levels of IL-6, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha in the cardiac tissue, significantly reduced the inflammatory cells, recovered the regular arrangement of myocardial cells, and decreased the area of perivascular fibrosis. The high-dose group of QD-WXF had the best effect. According to the prediction results of network pharmacology and molecular docking, the key pathway between QD-WXF and DIC was the STING pathway. In addition, QD-WXF up-regulated the level of phosphorylated STING(p-STING)/STING. In the STING~(KO) mouse experiment, the results of cardiac function evaluation and inflammatory index detection of the wild type(WT) group were consistent with those of C57BL/6J mice. QD-WXF downregulated the protein levels of phosphorylated TANK-binding kinase 1(p-TBK1), phosphorylated interferon regulatory factor 3(p-IRF3), and phosphorylated nuclear factor kappaB(p-NF-kappaB). In the experiment with STING~(KO), there was no significant difference between the QD-WXF group and the model group, while significant differences existed between the WT model group and the STING~(KO) model group. The above results indicate that QD-WXF can effectively alleviate doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity by inhibiting the inflammation via the cGAS/STING/NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 为探讨清毒温心方（QD-WXF）对多柔比星诱导的心脏毒性（DIC）的保护作用及机制，以及QD-WXF对环磷酸鸟苷-腺苷酸合成酶（cGAS）/干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）/核因子（NF）-κB信号通路的调控作用。将C57BL/6J小鼠随机分为对照组、模型组、普伐他汀（40 mg·kg~(-1)）组以及QD-WXF低（1.3 g·kg~(-1)）、中（2.6 g·kg~(-1)）、高（5.2 g·kg~(-1)）剂量组。通过尾静脉注射多柔比星建立DIC小鼠模型，随后灌胃给药四周。采用超声心动图、乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）检测和肌钙蛋白Ⅰ（TNⅠ）检测评估心脏功能。通过苏木精-伊红染色和Masson三色染色评估心肌组织病理学。采用RT-qPCR检测心脏组织中白细胞介素（IL）-6、肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）-α和IL-1β的mRNA水平。利用网络药理学和分子对接预测QD-WXF与DIC相关的关键通路，并通过Western blot评估STING蛋白水平。制备STING基因敲除（STING~(KO)）小鼠以验证STING通路及炎症相关蛋白的表达变化。动物实验结果显示，QD-WXF低、中、高剂量均不同程度地提高了射血分数（EF）和缩短分数（FS），降低了心肌损伤标志物LDH和TNⅠ，下调了心脏组织中IL-6、IL-1β和TNF-α的mRNA水平，显著减少了炎症细胞，恢复了心肌细胞的规则排列，并减少了血管周围纤维化面积。其中QD-WXF高剂量组效果最佳。根据网络药理学和分子对接的预测结果，QD-WXF与DIC之间的关键通路为STING通路。此外，QD-WXF上调了磷酸化STING（p-STING）/STING的水平。在STING~(KO)小鼠实验中，野生型（WT）组的心脏功能评估和炎症指标检测结果与C57BL/6J小鼠一致。QD-WXF下调了磷酸化TANK结合激酶1（p-TBK1）、磷酸化干扰素调节因子3（p-IRF3）和磷酸化核因子κB（p-NF-κB）的蛋白水平。在STING~(KO)实验中，QD-WXF组与模型组之间无显著差异，而WT模型组与STING~(KO)模型组之间存在显著差异。上述结果表明，QD-WXF通过抑制cGAS/STING/NF-κB通路介导的炎症反应，能有效缓解多柔比星诱导的心脏毒性。
